questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

He won’t come to the party unless you __will invite__ him personally.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'invite'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the usage of 'will invite' is incorrect instead of it use 'invite'
 
• According to grammar, whenever we have a main clause and subordinate clause in the conditional sentence, the usage of will is incorrect in the subordinate clauses hence, we need to omit 'will' from the subordinate clause.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Unless you call me to say you're not coming, I'll see you at the theatre (= I will see you there if you do not call to say you are not coming).
 
 

**Hence, the correct sentence is-** *He won't come to the party unless **you invite** him personally.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__***

 
• The word "invited" is in the past tense, and using it in this context would imply that the invitation would have already occurred in the past. However, the sentence is speaking about a future event (the party) and a condition that must be met in the future (the personal invitation).
 
• The verb tenses in the two parts of this conditional sentence need to match. If the first part is in the future tense ("He won't come to the party"), then the second part also needs to be in a tense that refers to future action. The base form of the verb ("invite") is used here to express a condition in the present or future.
 
• If we were talking about a past event, "invited" could be correct. For example: "He didn't come to the party unless you invited him personally."
 
• So, "invite" is the correct option in this context.

If x + 1/x = k, then x − 1/x = √(k² − 4).

Here, k = √13, so x − 1/x = √(13 − 4) = √9 = 3.

If x − 1/x = a, then x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.

Substituting a = 3, we get: 3³ + 3 × 3 = 27 + 9 = 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

(a − b)² = (a + b)² − 4ab

a³ − b³ = (a − b)³ + 3ab(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (x + 1/x)² − 4(x)(1/x)

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (√13)² − 4

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 13 − 4 = 9

⇒ x − 1/x = ±3

Taking x − 1/x = 3 (since the positive value matches the given options):

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x)(1/x)(x − 1/x)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 3³ + 3 × 3

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 27 + 9 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

Sum of Squares Identity

Difference of Squares Transition

The relationship between the sum and difference of reciprocal terms is given by the identity (x + 1/x)² − (x − 1/x)² = 4.

Sum of Cubes Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k. This comes from rearranging the expansion of (x + 1/x)³.

Difference of Cubes Identity

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k. This is an essential shortcut for quickly solving differences of cubed terms in algebra.

questions.question: Which of the following gases is released in the process of photosynthesis?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxygen**__.

__
 
• In the presence of sunlight Carbon dioxide + water + sunlight → Carbohydrate + oxygen.
 
• So Carbon dioxide is absorbed while Oxygen gas is released in the process. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Photosynthesis: 
 
• The leaves have a green pigment called chlorophyll.
 
 
• It helps leaves to capture the energy of the sunlight.
 
• This energy is used to synthesise food from carbon dioxide and water. 
 
• Since the synthesis of food occurs in the presence of sunlight, it is called photosynthesis.
 
 
 
• Some plants, green algae, and cyanobacteria can perform photosynthesis.
 
• Photosynthesis occurs in the chloroplasts specifically, in the grana and stroma regions.
 
• The process of photosynthesis is commonly written as:

​

• The following events occur in plant cells during photosynthesis.

__
 
• **Alluvial soil is not found In the Himalayan region.**
 
• **Alluvial soils:**
 
 
• These soils are called** transported soil** because although they are formed near the water bodies, these soils get transported from their origin to several other places by various natural agents, especially by gravity.
 
• The alluvial soil is made up of particles like **silt, sand, and clay and has an adequate amount of phosphoric acid, potash, and lime.**
 
• It is of two types:
 
 
• The older alluvial soil is known as **Bhangar.**
 
• The newer alluvial soil is known as** Khadar.**
 
 
 
• The alluvial soil covers a total of** 40%** of the land.
 
• These soils are found in the **northern plains beginning from Punjab to West Bengal and Assam.**
 
• It is also** found in deltas of rivers like Krishna, Godavari, Kaveri, and Mahanadi in peninsular India.**
 
• The** main crops **cultivated are wheat, rice, maize, sugarcane, pulses, and oilseeds.

• On the** basis of the size of the particles **that make up a soil defines its gardening characteristics:

• **Saline soil:**
 
 
• It refers to Arid soil.
 
• These are derived from the disintegration of adjacent rocks and are largely blown from coastal regions and the Indus valley.
 
• They are developed in western Rajasthan. Due to the dry climate, high temperature and accelerated evaporation, they lack moisture and humus.
 
 
 
• **Calcerous soil:**
 
 
• They are also known as chalky soils.
 
• These soils contain calcium carbonate or lime.
 
• They are very alkaline and may be light or heavy.

questions.question: A device or program that enables a computer to transmit data over telephone or cable lines is called:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Modem.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​****A modem** is a device or program that enables a computer to transmit data over, for example, telephone or cable lines.
 
• Computer information is stored digitally, whereas information transmitted over telephone lines is transmitted in the form of analog waves.
 
• A modem is a hardware device that allows a computer to send and receive data over a telephone line or a cable or satellite connection.
 
• MODEM stands for **modulator-demodulator**.
 
• A modem is used for** transmitting and receiving data over a communication channel,** such as twisted-pair telephone lines, coaxial cables, and optical fibers.
 
• At the source, the modulation technique is used to convert the analog signal to digital.
 
• At the receiver, demodulation is used to convert the digital signal back to analog.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​A motherboard:**

 
 
• It is also called mainboard, main circuit board, system board, baseboard, planar board, logic board, or mobo and is the main printed circuit board (PCB) in general-purpose computers.
 
 
 
• **The monitor:**
 
 
• It is the output device that helps to display soft copy.
 
 
 
• **A computer mouse:**
 
 
• It is an input device used to control/operate a computer.
 
• Douglas Engelbart invented the computer Mouse.
 
• A mouse tracks the 2-D movement on the surface it is kept/used and correspondingly moves the pointer on the monitor.
 
• Engelbart has also founded a separate field, human-computer interaction (HCI).
 
• A human using the mouse to interact with a computer would come under the ambit of HCI.
